projects.title: Reinforcents
projects.summary: A full market simulator where multiple RL agents trade stocks and options in a shared environment with configurable volatility and liquidity. Agents learn independently while competing — closer to how real markets behave than any toy problem.

projects.title: Dekho
projects.summary: A real-time assistive navigation system for the visually impaired. Combines open-vocabulary object detection with monocular depth estimation to describe the environment as it changes — built for people who can't afford to wait on a response.

projects.title: Rockfall Prediction System
projects.summary: Predicts rockfall hazard zones by generating digital elevation models from terrain data and simulating boulder trajectories across the surface. Turns raw geospatial data into risk maps that could actually inform infrastructure decisions.

projects.title: GridRunner
projects.summary: Implemented Q-Learning, SARSA, and Expected SARSA from scratch to train maze-solving agents — no libraries doing the heavy lifting. A clean comparison of how subtle differences in update rules change agent behavior over time.

projects.title: Face Recognition Login System
projects.summary: Replaced password-based login with facial biometrics by writing a custom PAM module that hooks directly into the Linux authentication stack. No middleware, no shortcuts — the OS calls the model at login time.

projects.title: Cache Management System
projects.summary: A C++ simulator that models cache behavior across multiple replacement policies and coherence strategies. Built to understand what actually happens at the memory hierarchy level — not just what textbooks say should happen.
